437:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It looks like we're under attack.」

437:t_1:88.en:
$$宗介$$
「So $$サイデリアル$$ is coming...」

437:t_1:89.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Whatever comes, let's move forward, however difficult the road may be.」

437:t_1:90.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'm waiting, $n. I'm waiting for you to stand up again.)

437:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(The man I believe in can't possibly be that weak.)

437:t_2:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「This cold, deep darkness that stretches on forever... Is this $n's despair...?」

437:t_2:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「Without my brother's power... the darkness inside me, my mind might have been destroyed in an instant.」

437:t_2:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Deepest of all... Is this where $n's despair takes root...?」

437:t_2:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「That long black hair...! Is that $n...?!」

437:t_2:10.en:
$n
「Please stop...! I'll... I'll be good, so please...」

437:t_2:11.en:
$$メグミ$$
「You're going to die with me! There's no point in living... in a world like this!」

437:t_2:12.en:
$n
「N-no! I... I don't want to die! Mom, you're acting crazy!!」

437:t_2:13.en:
$n
「I want to see Dad and Sis again, and I want to keep living with you, Mom!」

437:t_2:14.en:
$$メグミ$$
「It's all right, $f. After Mommy kills you, Mommy will die too.」

437:t_2:18.en:
$$メグミ$$
「See... Because you struggled... Now you've got a cut on that sweet little face.」

437:t_2:26.en:
$$タケル$$
「...$n... His mother tried to kill him...」

437:t_2:29.en:
$n
(And Mom... right in front... of me... took... her own... life...)

437:t_2:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't let the past swallow you, $n! Your life belongs to you!!」

437:t_2:36.en:
$$カレン$$
「$n! We've all come to bring you back!」

437:t_2:37.en:
$$シン$$
「Wake up! Don't let despair beat you!」

437:t_2:38.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We know the darkness inside you now.」

437:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「If it hurts, lean on us! We might not be able to do anything, but we can at least listen!」

437:t_2:40.en:
$$葵$$
「If we can ease the despair you're carrying even a little, we'll help!」

437:t_2:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll fight together to keep your hope alive!」

437:t_2:43.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We're your friends, moving into the future together!」

437:t_2:44.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... might not be able to do anything, but I'll still fight with you!」

437:t_2:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You need hard work and determination!」

437:t_2:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You've got the $$ボランティア部$$ spirit too!」

437:t_2:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「There must be a sun inside your heart too!」

437:t_2:51.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let it burst out! Just like you always do!!」

437:t_2:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've seen you do it time and again!」

437:t_2:53.en:
$$キラ$$
「So we believe in you this time too!」

437:t_2:55.en:
$$桂$$
「You can't enjoy anything fun or happy unless you're alive!」

437:t_2:58.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you going to abandon the way of life you taught me halfway through?!」

437:t_2:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's right. Your journey is still only halfway over.」

437:t_2:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is it no use...?! Can't we save $n?!」

437:t_2:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You can still fight! You have to fight, don't you?!」

437:t_2:69.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's useless. His darkness goes deeper than you can imagine.」

437:t_2:72.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「His parents divorced when he was small. The mother who took him in tried to kill him, scarring his mind and body...」

437:t_2:73.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Then, after his father took him in, his father and sister were killed by an artificially induced $$時空震動$$...」

437:t_2:74.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now the man who killed his family toys with him. His former lover serves that man, and the woman he loves will soon disappear...」

437:t_2:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is going to disappear?!」

437:t_2:76.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「To be precise, she'll sink to the bottom of our consciousness and never be able to surface again.」
